summary: community.vmware deprecated several VMwareRestClient methods (get_datacenter_by_name, get_datastore_by_name, get_host_by_name, library item lookups, get_resource_pool_by_name, get_tags_for_cluster, vmware_client_argument_spec), for removal in community.vmware 8.0.0.
questions: My custom module uses vmware_client_argument_spec, will it break?
When will community.vmware remove the REST client helper methods?

answer_card.title: community.vmware: deprecated VMwareRestClient methods
answer_card.answer_md:
Deprecated in `plugins.module_utils.vmware_rest_client.VMwareRestClient`, removal in **community.vmware 8.0.0**:

- `get_datacenter_by_name`, `get_datastore_by_name`, `get_host_by_name`, `get_resource_pool_by_name`
- `get_library_item_by_name`, `get_library_item_from_content_library_name`
- `get_tags_for_cluster`, `vmware_client_argument_spec`

Custom modules relying on these should vendor the logic or move to `vmware.vmware` utilities.
